title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics priority weighting for SLO/toolkit helpers
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Enhancement: incident-bot now weights autodiagnostics suggestions with SLO/toolkit signals to improve runbook ranking and reduce noisy suggestions.
description: Motivation: on-call autodiagnostics were producing too many low-value runbook suggestions during SLO incidents. This change augments the existing heuristic scorer with SLO-toolkit signals (error budget proximity, recent burn rate, service priority) and runbook metadata (last-successful-run, author confidence) to compute a priority weight for suggestions. The approach is feature-flagged and backward-compatible: if the flag is off we fall back to the previous ranking. Implementation: add a PriorityWeightCalculator that consumes the SLO hint vector, runbook metadata, and recent on-call feedback to produce a 0.0-1.0 score. Wire the calculator into the autodiagnostics pipeline, persist the score on suggestion objects, and surface the score in on-call summaries and runbook quicklinks. Also add a sampling telemetry event to track top-K suggestion precision and a per-runbook acceptance counter to enable future ML-driven tuning. Config: new config schema under incident_bot.config.suggestions.priority with tunable coefficients and a sampling rate. Rollout plan: behind feature flag incident_bot.suggestions.priority_v2, enable for 10% of SLO-triggered incidents for 48h, evaluate telemetry, then increase to 100% if precision improves >8 percentage points. Backwards compatibility & safety: default coefficients are conservative; invalid config entries are ignored and logged; scoring is clamped and cannot suppress high-confidence runbooks marked critical. Tests & docs: unit tests for calculator, integration tests simulating SLO events, new e2e scenario in perf-canary that exercises priority sampling, and docs updated in docs/oncall/runbooks.md. Checklist: - Unit tests added and passing; - Integration tests added and run in CI; - Feature flag added and defaults to off; - Docs updated; - Telemetry events instrumented. Related work: references ENG-2145 for scoring design and ENG-2199 for telemetry targets. Continuous description: no breaking API changes, small DB add (nullable score column), migration included in this PR.
